review_findings.title: Installed local records currently expose Download unconditionally
review_findings.details: ModelsView computes canDownload = model.backend === ollama for every discovered row, even though Tauri discovery returns local runtime inventory records with availability=available. This creates a Download action for already-installed artifacts.

review_findings.title: The discovery boundary must remain honest
